title: Crisis behaviour
question: How hard did it fall in a crisis, and how fast did it recover?
findings: 2020 COVID-19 crash: smallest fall SPY (−33.7%), largest NVDA (−37.6%).
2022 rate shock: smallest fall SPY (−24.5%), largest NVDA (−61.8%).
notes: Windows: 19 Feb – 23 Mar 2020 (S&P 500 peak to trough) and 3 Jan – 12 Oct 2022. The fall is the lowest close vs the price at the window start.
Dividends included (adjusted prices). Past crises do not predict the next one.

sources.label: Yahoo Finance prices (adjusted for splits and dividends)
